svg.title: Retail Inventory Manual Work Owner Dashboard Demo
svg.desc: Demo-only owner dashboard for retail inventory manual work. It shows synthetic stock-count, reorder, supplier follow-up, purchase-order and dead-stock owner queues with no real store data, supplier data, sales data, savings, ROI or stock accuracy claim.

g.text: Retail Inventory Manual Work Owner Dashboard
DEMO / SYNTHETIC ONLY — no real store, supplier, POS, ERP, customer, sales, savings, ROI or stock-accuracy claim
stock, reorder, PO and supplier queues
pricing, expiry, supplier and cash flow
no savings or stockout results asserted
1. Stock-count ageing: category, shelf, branch or warehouse count is stale; owner must approve recount evidence.
2. Reorder triggers: separate true low-stock signals from gut-feel buying, seasonality and cash-flow approvals.
3. Supplier follow-up: track delayed dispatch, substitutions, invoice questions and credit notes without raw contracts.
4. Purchase-order handoff: buyer, finance, store and warehouse each have a named next action and due date.
5. Dead-stock decisions: markdown, transfer, return-to-vendor or hold rows stay human-owned before automation.
6. Claim gate: block stock accuracy, stockout reduction, margin, sales, savings and ROI wording until measured proof exists.

svg.text: AICloudStrategist demo artifact generated 2026-08-28 for global retail workflow buyer visibility.
